Root Cause:
Investigated the raw inbound feed and confirmed that CTC is sending postal_code in the composites block for Mark's transactions. However, this field was never implemented in the Marks data pipeline — most likely because the field was not present in the original feed when the Marks integration was first set up. As a result, no code exists to extract and store it.

Findings:

  • postal_code is present in the raw feed (K8A 0J9 confirmed for reference transaction)

  • No customer ID or customer information is present in the transaction — postal_code is a transaction-level attribute only

  • Field needs to be mapped as a new extended field in the Header table

Changes Required:

  • parsers/marks.py

  • tlog_177.staging_ardm_header_update_marks (+ create tlog scripts)

  • ardm_177.ardm_header_update (+ create ardm scripts)

  • ardm_177.ardm_header

Next Steps:
Will make the necessary code changes and run testing. Target to have changes tested by Friday.

Thanks & Regards,

Appriss Retail Support

ARDM/backend changes for RCS-27947 (x_postalcode)

All changes are currently uncommitted on dev_bkumar — nothing merged yet, pending review. JSON/setup_dev.py edits from earlier work are also still sitting there, untouched.

Summary of changes:

File

Change

marks.py

Renamed x_marks_postalcode → x_postalcode

ctp.py

Added composites.postal_code extraction (.strip()[:20], None-safe) — new, wasn't there before

ps.py

Same addition as CTP

ardm_create.sql

Renamed column in all 3 header tables

create_tlog_{marks,ps,ctp,fgl}.sql

Renamed column in each banner's staging table

ARDM_80_TransactionFastFact.sql

Renamed in INSERT column list and SELECT — covers all 4 banners since it reads off the pre-unioned staging table

Verified clean/consistent: no leftover x_marks_postalcode anywhere in code, x_postalcode is uniformly CHARACTER VARYING(20) across all 3 header tables and all 4 banner staging tables, fact-table INSERT/SELECT updated accordingly.

Left alone, on purpose:

  • FGL — no composites block exists in its source format at all, so no extraction was added; x_postalcode stays NULL for FGL. customerpostcode (FGL's actual populated field) is a different, unrelated concept — customer's home address, on a different table — left untouched.

  • Secure snapshot display layer — not in this repo, couldn't verify/change ticket item 2 here. Still open on whether to point this at another repo or split into a follow-up ticket.

  • CTP/PS being otherwise-unimplemented stubs — pre-existing gap, flagged but not touched beyond the postal code piece.

Pre-existing, unrelated issues found while testing (not caused by these changes, not fixed here):

  • test_marks.py::test_exchange already fails on dev_bkumar before these edits (confirmed via stash) — KeyError: 'stdtransactiontype'.

  • test_ctp.py / test_ps.py both do from fgla import parse — a module that doesn't exist, so these tests don't even import, let alone test CTP/PS.

  • test_fgl.py fails to import locally due to a missing appriss_logger package in this environment.

Testing: Tested in Staging — x_postalcode is now populating correctly end-to-end. Screenshot attached below.
